text: Which of the following fractions is the largest?
textHi: निम्न में से सबसे बड़ी भिन्न कौन सी है?
explanation: Convert to decimals: 3/4 = 0.75, 5/6 ≈ 0.833, 7/9 ≈ 0.778, 11/15 ≈ 0.733. Alternatively use LCM 180: 135/180, 150/180, 140/180, 132/180. Shortcut: compare each fraction's shortfall from 1 — 1/4, 1/6, 2/9, 4/15; the smallest shortfall (1/6) gives the largest fraction.
examRelevance: Comparison of fractions is a standard 16-mark-section question.

text: A number is divisible by 9 if:
textHi: एक संख्या 9 से विभाज्य होती है यदि:

options.whyIncorrect: e.g., 19 ends in 9 but is not divisible by 9.

options.text: The sum of its digits is divisible by 9
Its last two digits are divisible by 9
options.whyIncorrect: That pattern is the rule for 4 (last two digits divisible by 4), not 9.

explanation: Divisibility rules: 2 (even last digit), 3 & 9 (digit sum divisible by 3/9), 4 (last two digits), 5 (ends in 0/5), 6 (divisible by 2 and 3), 8 (last three digits), 10 (ends in 0), 11 (alternating digit-sum difference divisible by 11).
source: NCERT Class 6 Mathematics, Playing with Numbers
examRelevance: Divisibility is explicitly listed in the official syllabus.

text: The price of a book was increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. The net change in price is:
textHi: एक पुस्तक का मूल्य 20% बढ़ाया गया और फिर 20% घटाया गया। मूल्य में शुद्ध परिवर्तन है:

options.whyIncorrect: Successive equal % increase and decrease never cancel out — the decrease acts on a larger base.
Sign is wrong; the net effect is a decrease.

explanation: Let price = 100. After +20% → 120. After −20% of 120 → 120 − 24 = 96. Net −4%. Formula for successive changes a% and b%: a + b + ab/100 = 20 − 20 − 4 = −4%.

text: A shopkeeper buys a pen for ₹40 and sells it for ₹50. His profit percentage is:
textHi: एक दुकानदार ₹40 में एक पेन खरीदता है और ₹50 में बेचता है। उसका लाभ प्रतिशत है:

options.whyIncorrect: 20% would be the result if profit were computed on selling price (10/50) — profit % is always on cost price.
₹10 is the absolute profit, not the percentage.

explanation: Profit = SP − CP = 50 − 40 = ₹10. Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100 = (10/40) × 100 = 25%. Remember profit/loss percent is always calculated on the cost price unless stated otherwise.
examRelevance: Profit-loss basics — expect at least one question.

text: The simple interest on ₹5,000 at 8% per annum for 3 years is:
textHi: ₹5,000 पर 8% वार्षिक दर से 3 वर्ष का साधारण ब्याज है:

options.whyIncorrect: ₹1,298.56 is the COMPOUND interest for the same data (5000×1.08³ − 5000).
₹400 is the interest for ONE year only.

explanation: SI = (P × R × T)/100 = (5000 × 8 × 3)/100 = ₹1,200. Compound interest for the same case would be 5000(1.08)³ − 5000 ≈ ₹1,298.56 — CI exceeds SI from the 2nd year.
source: NCERT Class 7–8 Mathematics, Simple & Compound Interest

text: The average of 5 numbers is 27. If one number is excluded, the average becomes 25. The excluded number is:
textHi: 5 संख्याओं का औसत 27 है। यदि एक संख्या हटा दी जाए तो औसत 25 हो जाता है। हटाई गई संख्या है:
explanation: Sum of 5 numbers = 5 × 27 = 135. Sum of remaining 4 = 4 × 25 = 100. Excluded number = 135 − 100 = 35.

text: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5. If 9 is added to each, the ratio becomes 3 : 4. The numbers are:
textHi: दो संख्याएँ 3 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं। यदि प्रत्येक में 9 जोड़ा जाए तो अनुपात 3 : 4 हो जाता है। संख्याएँ हैं:
explanation: Let numbers be 3x and 5x. (3x+9)/(5x+9) = 3/4 ⇒ 12x + 36 = 15x + 27 ⇒ 3x = 9 ⇒ x = 3. Numbers: 9 and 15. Check: 18 : 24 = 3 : 4 ✓.
examRelevance: Ratio with added constant — standard type.

text: The area of a rhombus whose diagonals are 12 cm and 16 cm is:
textHi: एक समचतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल जिसके विकर्ण 12 सेमी और 16 सेमी हैं:

options.whyIncorrect: 192 = d1 × d2 — you forgot to halve.
56 = 2(12+16) would be the perimeter of a 12×16 rectangle, unrelated.

explanation: Area of rhombus = ½ × d1 × d2 = ½ × 12 × 16 = 96 cm². Bonus: side = √(6² + 8²) = 10 cm, so perimeter = 40 cm.
examRelevance: Mensuration formulas — area of rhombus/trapezium common.

text: A cuboidal water tank is 3 m long, 2 m wide and 1.5 m high. Its capacity in litres is:
textHi: एक घनाभाकार पानी की टंकी 3 मी लंबी, 2 मी चौड़ी और 1.5 मी ऊँची है। इसकी क्षमता लीटर में है:

options.whyIncorrect: Too large — 1 m³ = 1000 L, not 10,000 L.
6.5 is the sum of dimensions, not the product.

explanation: Volume = l × b × h = 3 × 2 × 1.5 = 9 m³. Since 1 m³ = 1000 litres, capacity = 9,000 L.
examRelevance: Unit conversion m³ ↔ litre is frequently tested.

textHi: यदि x + 1/x = 5, तो x² + 1/x² का मान है:

options.whyIncorrect: 25 is (x + 1/x)²; you must subtract the cross term 2.
27 would be correct for x − 1/x = 5 (add 2 instead of subtract).

explanation: (x + 1/x)² = x² + 2 + 1/x². So x² + 1/x² = 5² − 2 = 23. Companion results: x³ + 1/x³ = 5³ − 3×5 = 110.
examRelevance: Identity-based questions are the typical 'सर्वसमिका' item.

text: The HCF of two numbers is 12 and their LCM is 180. If one number is 36, the other is:
textHi: दो संख्याओं का म.स. 12 और ल.स. 180 है। यदि एक संख्या 36 है, तो दूसरी है:
explanation: Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM ⇒ 36 × n = 12 × 180 = 2160 ⇒ n = 60. Check: HCF(36,60) = 12, LCM = 180 ✓.

text: 12 workers can build a wall in 15 days. How many days will 20 workers take to build the same wall (working at the same rate)?
textHi: 12 मजदूर एक दीवार 15 दिन में बनाते हैं। 20 मजदूर उसी दीवार को कितने दिन में बनाएँगे?

options.whyIncorrect: 25 would result from a direct (wrong) proportion; more workers ⇒ fewer days.

explanation: Total work = 12 × 15 = 180 worker-days. Days for 20 workers = 180 / 20 = 9. This is inverse variation — a core idea of the unitary method.
source: NCERT Class 8, Direct and Inverse Proportions

text: The median of the data 7, 3, 9, 5, 11, 13, 1 is:

options.whyIncorrect: 5 is the 3rd value in sorted order; median of 7 values is the 4th.
9 is the 5th value in sorted order.

explanation: Arrange in order: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13. n = 7 (odd) ⇒ median = (n+1)/2 = 4th term = 7. Mean = 49/7 = 7 too. Mode: none (all values occur once).

text: The sum of the interior angles of a hexagon is:
textHi: एक षट्भुज के अंतःकोणों का योग है:

options.whyIncorrect: 540° is the sum for a pentagon (5 sides).
360° is for a quadrilateral (and the sum of exterior angles of any polygon).

explanation: Sum of interior angles = (n − 2) × 180° = (6 − 2) × 180° = 720°. Each interior angle of a regular hexagon = 120°.
examRelevance: Polygon angle sum is a routine geometry question.

text: In the number 4,072.35, the place value of 7 is:

options.whyIncorrect: 7 is the face value, not the place value.
7 is in the tens place, not hundreds.
7 is to the left of the decimal point.

explanation: Reading 4,072.35: 4 thousands, 0 hundreds, 7 tens, 2 ones, 3 tenths, 5 hundredths. Place value of 7 = 7 × 10 = 70. Face value is always the digit itself (7).
source: NCERT Class 5–6 Mathematics, Place Value and Decimals
examRelevance: Place value vs face value is a common trap.
